{{Quote|1=Jayterr = programmed for information gathering + dissemination // Gossip = hobby|2=J8R-1|3=<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''J8R-1''', nicknamed '''Jayterr''', was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. J8R-1 served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] as a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] on, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and later [[Carrick Station]], delivering messages and mission briefings from the [[Republic Emergency Response Corps|Emergency Response Corps]] to Republic personnel aboard. During the Cold War, he transmitted a message from [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] to a group of heroes, asking them to come to Carrick Station for a [[Battle for Hammer Station|mission]]. He was excited about them working for Master Satele and hoped to hear their stories when they would come back.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
J8R-1 is a [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Flashpoint|Flashpoint]] courier in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He appears on Coruscant, Taris, and Carrick Station, delivering a message to players from Grand Master Satele Shan about the "Hammer Station" flashpoint.<ref name="TOR" />
